hypotheses.reasoning: Third-party translation API (api.translate.example) began returning 502/503 at 08:46. catalog-svc's circuit breaker opened, so catalog-svc returned 503 to search-api, and that showed up as 503s on GET /search at web-bff. The half-open probe at 08:55 still got a 502, so the provider is still down. None of the other services logged warnings or errors before this.
The circuit breaker spread the translation failures to every catalog request, so it made the damage bigger than it needed to be.

verdict.recommendedAction: Contact the translation API provider or check its status page. Make catalog-svc degrade gracefully when translation fails, either by serving untranslated text or by skipping translation on the search path, so that search keeps working while the breaker is open.
